title: Review Queue Output Artifact (C5, s104-m02)
description: Agent-readable JSON artifact produced by the review-queue emitter. Composable with s103-m01 review.resolve as the INPUT to policy evaluation. Each entry summarizes an entity's confidence tier and the top-N lowest sub-signals from oods.confidence_decomposition; the summary aggregates per-tier counts and the review-flagged count.

entries.description: One entry per included entity. Sorted by score ascending (lowest-confidence first, unknown-tier entities precede all numeric scores). Includes all manifest entities by default; when options.flaggedOnly is true, only entries with flaggedForReview=true are present.

tier.description: Confidence tier classification per review-emitter.classifyTier — high ≥0.8, medium 0.5–0.8, low <0.5, unknown when confidence_decomposition is absent.

score.description: confidence_decomposition.total, or null when confidence_decomposition is absent on the entity.

flaggedForReview.description: True when the entity needs human review per review-emitter.needsReview — score < reviewThreshold OR tier === 'unknown'.

lowestSignals.description: Top-N lowest-scoring sub-signals (ascending by score, stable for ties). Empty array when confidence_decomposition is absent or has no signals. N is options.lowestSignalsN (default 3).

elementName.description: Mirror of entity.element.name. Surfaced so consuming agents can display the queue without re-resolving the entity from the source manifest.

entitiesTotal.description: Total entities in the source manifest (regardless of flaggedOnly).

entitiesIncluded.description: Entities included in entries[] after applying flaggedOnly filter.

flaggedCount.description: Count of entities for which needsReview() is true — below threshold OR tier=unknown. Counted across ALL manifest entities, not just included ones.

reviewThreshold.description: Effective review threshold (options.reviewThreshold, default 0.7). Surfaced for reproducibility.

lowestSignalsN.description: Effective top-N selector for lowestSignals (options.lowestSignalsN, default 3).

sourceManifest.description: Identifier of the manifest the queue was derived from. Default: manifest.source.agent (or 'unknown' when manifest.source is absent). Surfaced so agents can trace queue → manifest provenance.
